source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: [Aetherstride](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.daemon-prince-of-tzeentch-with-wings.aetherstride) gives the Daemon Prince of Tzeentch with Wings a **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** option in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase): set it up over 6″ from all enemy units, measured horizontally. The Daemon Prince of Tzeentch with Wings cannot charge that turn and its Dark Blessing gains **[[SUSTAINED HITS D3]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** through turn end.
